name: file-tree-pane
description: Keeps a live file tree of your project beside the chat: git status and line counts, what Claude reads, writes and commits, search, previews, diffs and your editor one key away.

activity.title: Claude activity
activity.description: What shimmers in the tree as Claude works: reads and searches (purple), writes (orange) and commits (green). Git status, line counts and the git footer always show.

followClaude.title: Follow Claude
followClaude.description: Scroll the tree to what Claude reads, writes or commits, opening folders to show it. Off keeps the view where you put it; the highlights still show.

openAtStart.title: Open at start
openAtStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts, where the terminal is wide enough to dock it. Off keeps it closed until you run /file-tree.

rightColumn.title: Right column
rightColumn.description: What the right column shows when a session starts: the modification date, its age (now, 12m, 3h, 5d, Oct 9, 2025) or the size. The Σ button switches to sizes and back.

hints.title: Hints
hints.description: Show a line under the header outside a git repository saying git status starts after git init.

searchSpacing.title: Search spacing
searchSpacing.description: Keep a blank line above and below the search field. Off gives the tree those two rows.

shortcutRow.title: Shortcut row
shortcutRow.description: Show the j/k/h/l/open/search buttons under the search field. Off hides them; the keys still work with the tree focused.

openWith.title: Open with
openWith.description: Empty opens files in their default app on double-click or Enter. editor opens $VISUAL, then $EDITOR, then vi, in a tmux window or a herdr pane. Anything else is a command, such as code -g {path}.

editWith.title: Edit with
editWith.description: What e opens at the line in view. Empty uses $VISUAL, then $EDITOR, then vi at +line, in a tmux window or a herdr pane. Otherwise a command where {path} is the file and {line} the line, such as zed {path}:{line}.

diffWith.title: Diff with
diffWith.description: What d does on a changed file or folder. Empty shows the diff in the pane. Otherwise a terminal command run on the path in a tmux window, a herdr pane or, on Linux, a new terminal window, such as hunk diff -- or lazygit -f.

ignore.title: Ignore
ignore.description: File and folder names to leave out of the tree, its search and its highlights, separated by spaces or commas, such as .cache .tmp. Names match exactly at any depth; .git and node_modules are always left out.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Your own colors over the theme's, as tone=#rrggbb pairs: read, write, commit, modified, added, deleted, untracked, conflict, muted, accent, selected, hovered.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: auto uses Nerd Font icons in a terminal that has a Nerd Font installed before it started, and over SSH; plain Unicode in the desktop app or without a Nerd Font. nerd or plain forces one.
